title: $f^*\circ p_Y^*\cong p_X^*$ is monoidal
statement:
The natural isomorphism $f^*\circ p_Y^*\cong p_X^*$ of
[def-sfb-pullback-from-point-comp-iso] is monoidal. That is, it is compatible
with the unit and tensor comparison isomorphisms of the strong monoidal
functors $f^*\circ p_Y^*$ and $p_X^*$, for the tensor products of
[sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor].

proof.text: The canonical inverse-image adjunctions for f and the structure morphism of Y are monoidal by [lem-sfb-finite-monoidal-adjunction]; their composite is monoidal by the monoidal-composite adjunction instance. By [lem-sfb-pushforward-comp-monoidal], the comparison between the direct-image composite and the direct image of f followed by the structure morphism is monoidal. Apply the existing isMonoidal_conjugateEquiv_symm theorem to its inverse. This proves that the inverse of upperStarComp is monoidal for the canonical strong monoidal pullbacks of [def-sfb-finite-upper-star-monoidal].

For maps g,g prime from X to the terminal integer spectrum and an equality h:g=g prime, the natural transformation eqToIso(congrArg upperStar h).hom is monoidal: eliminate h and use monoidality of the identity natural transformation. In particular this applies to comp_toSpecZ f. Compose this monoidal equality comparison with the monoidal inverse-composition comparison from the first step.

By [def-sfb-pullback-from-point-comp-iso], upperStarFromPointComp is the functor associator followed by the whiskering of this composite comparison with pointUpperStar. The latter is strong monoidal by [lem-sfb-point-upper-star-braided], and upperStarFromPoint has its composite monoidal structure by [def-sfb-upper-star-from-point]. The associator, monoidal whiskering and composite of monoidal transformations are monoidal, giving precisely the claimed comparison.
